englishTitle: The Eternal Wisdom of God and Pope Leo I
addressee: To the Venerable Brethren the Patriarchs, Primates, Archbishops, Bishops, and other Local Ordinaries in Peace and Communion with the Apostolic See: Commemorating the fifteenth centenary of the death of St. Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church.
rawClosingDate: Given at Rome, at St. Peter’s, on the eleventh day of November in the year 1961, the fourth of Our Pontificate.
